title: Detailed paper plane
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Main body of the paper plane - right wing (top face, bright white-cyan) -->
  <polygon points="50,15 85,55 50,45" fill="#e8f4ff" stroke="#b3d9f2" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Left wing (top face, slightly darker to distinguish fold) -->
  <polygon points="50,15 15,55 50,45" fill="#cce8ff" stroke="#99ccee" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Center fold line highlight -->
  <line x1="50" y1="15" x2="50" y2="45" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Left wing underside (darker shade to show fold) -->
  <polygon points="15,55 50,45 50,85" fill="#88bbdd" stroke="#6699bb" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Right wing underside (medium shade) -->
  <polygon points="85,55 50,45 50,85" fill="#aad4ee" stroke="#88bbdd" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Keel / body bottom fold -->
  <polygon points="50,45 40,70 50,85" fill="#77aacc" stroke="#5599bb" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polygon points="50,45 60,70 50,85" fill="#99ccee" stroke="#77aacc" stroke-width="1"/>
  <!-- Nose tip highlight -->
  <polygon points="50,15 53,22 47,22" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e0f0ff" stroke-width="0.5"/>
  <!-- Right wing top fold detail lines -->
  <line x1="55" y1="25" x2="75" y2="50" stroke="#d0e8f8" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <!-- Left wing extra crease -->
  <line x1="45" y1="25" x2="25" y2="50" stroke="#b8ddf0" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3,3"/>
  <!-- Small shadow under the plane for depth (lighter shade, no dark colors) -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="90" rx="20" ry="4" fill="#5a88aa" opacity="0.4"/>
</svg>
